# ArchiCode

> ArchiCode is a command line tool and a browser editor for architecture as code: it reads a workspace of YAML manifests and renders C4 and ArchiMate views.

## Start here

- [Manual](https://tmorin.github.io/archicode/docs/): the full documentation of the command line and the manifests
- [Guide](https://tmorin.github.io/archicode/docs/#guide): how to describe an architecture and draw its views
- [Init](https://tmorin.github.io/archicode/docs/#init): create a first workspace with `archicode init`
- [Install](https://tmorin.github.io/archicode/docs/#install): install the binary
- [Editor](https://tmorin.github.io/archicode/editor/): the editor in the browser, no install
- [Repository](https://github.com/tmorin/archicode): the source code
- [Architecture of ArchiCode](https://github.com/tmorin/archicode/tree/main/docs/architecture): the ArchiCode model of ArchiCode

## Optional

- [Releases](https://github.com/tmorin/archicode/releases): the binaries of each version
